constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

description.text: The full supplied character reference sheet remains visible at the opening instant and throughout: a large hero panel occupies the upper area, three full-body turnaround views sit below it, and a row of four cropped detail panels runs along the bottom, with all borders, labels and the original dark studio backdrop intact. The hero panel depicts a rainy nighttime rooftop or elevated walkway with metal railings, blurred city lights and wet reflective surfaces. The person stands with arms at the sides and head turned slightly toward the viewer's left, wearing the black high-collared tactical jacket over a black shirt, black cargo trousers and black lace-up combat boots; the short cropped sides and small dark topknot remain consistent across every view. Cool blue-gray ambient light and warm amber city highlights define the hero panel, while the turnaround and detail panels keep their softer directional studio lighting. The face close-up shows a neutral, serious expression; the jacket collar detail shows black fabric with straps and a metal buckle; the hands detail shows relaxed, slightly curled fingers with visible grime; and the boots detail shows scuffed toes and thick soles. In the requested slow drifting motion, the still sheet becomes gently animated without changing its layout: rain streaks slide downward, wet rooftop reflections ripple, city lights shimmer, the hero figure breathes shallowly, and the loose collar edge stirs. The turnaround views, detail panels, labels and overall sheet composition stay fixed and fully legible as existing pixels; no new typography, no cropping, and no reformatting of the reference sheet is introduced. The camera holds a static shot, preserving the entire frame edge to edge.

The complete reference sheet fills the frame exactly as supplied, including the hero panel, front, side profile and back turnaround views, and the face, jacket collar, hands and boots detail panels, with every label and border visible.

Inside the hero panel, the figure keeps the observed standing stance with arms at the sides and head turned toward the viewer's left; the rain begins a slow downward drift while the other panels remain still.
A gentle rain patter and a faint distant city hum settle quietly under the scene.
The hero figure's shoulders rise and fall in a shallow breath, the high-collared black jacket shifting only slightly; the loose edge of the collar trembles while the topknot stays fixed.
Cool blue-gray highlights travel slowly across the wet railing and the blurred city lights, with small warm amber glints shimmering in the distance and the hero panel's reflections rippling in place.

The drifting rain continues down the hero panel as the figure maintains the same slight head turn and arms-at-sides posture; the jacket, cargo trousers and boots retain their observed shape and material.
The soft rain and distant urban hum continue at a steady, low level through the final moments.

soundscape: Soft rain patter and a faint distant city hum.
